nodes.norm_label: dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus
nodes.id: notes/neuromelanin/Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus.md/Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus

nodes.label: Vagus Nerve
nodes.description: Cranial nerve X; longest cranial nerve providing parasympathetic innervation to heart, lungs, and GI tract; DMV contains neuromelanin neurons; proposed conduit for gut-to-brain alpha-synuclein spread

nodes.label: Melanogenesis
nodes.description: Biosynthetic pathway producing melanin pigments from L-Tyrosine via tyrosinase-catalyzed oxidations; in brain, catecholamine auto-oxidation yields neuromelanin

nodes.label: Eumelanin
nodes.description: Dark brown-to-black melanin built from DHI/DHICA indolic monomers; forms outer shell of neuromelanin granules; photoprotective and metal-binding

nodes.label: Pheomelanin
nodes.description: Sulfur-containing yellow-to-red melanin from cysteine-conjugated dopaquinone; forms proposed core of neuromelanin granules; more redox-labile than eumelanin

nodes.label: Benzothiazine
nodes.description: Heterocyclic scaffold with benzene fused to thiazine ring; hallmark structural motif of pheomelanin; found in neuromelanin core reflecting mixed eumelanic/pheomelanic chemistry

nodes.label: 5,6-indolequinone
nodes.description: Late-stage reactive indolic quinone intermediate in dopamine oxidative polymerization; principal monomeric building block of neuromelanin polymer backbone

nodes.label: Dopamine o-quinone
nodes.description: Highly reactive ortho-quinone oxidation product of dopamine; central reactive intermediate in spontaneous non-enzymatic neuromelanin polymerization pathway

nodes.label: Quinones
nodes.description: Cyclic diketones from aromatic compound oxidation; highly electrophilic and redox-active; sit at intersection of oxidative stress, alpha-synuclein modification, and neuromelanin formation

nodes.label: L-Tyrosine
nodes.description: Non-essential aromatic amino acid; foundational precursor for catecholamine neurotransmitters and melanin pigments; origin of biochemical pathways generating neuromelanin

nodes.label: Indole
nodes.description: Bicyclic aromatic heterocycle; core building block of indolic oligomers composing neuromelanin; underlies dark color and metal-binding capacity of the pigment

nodes.label: Melanocytes
nodes.description: Neural-crest-derived pigment cells in skin, hair, and eyes; synthesize eumelanin and pheomelanin via melanogenesis; share catechol-oxidation chemistry with neuromelanin neurons

nodes.label: Dopachrome tautomerase
nodes.description: Also TRP-2/DCT; catalyzes dopachrome tautomerization to DHICA during eumelanogenesis; influences neuromelanin composition and metal-binding properties

nodes.label: Tyrosinase-related protein-1
nodes.description: TRP-1; melanosomal copper enzyme in eumelanin biosynthesis; potential CNS expression debated; may influence neuromelanin eumelanic coating and redox properties

nodes.label: Tyrosinase-related protein-2
nodes.description: TRP-2; same as dopachrome tautomerase; melanosomal enzyme; upregulated in PD patient dopaminergic neurons suggesting altered neuromelanin production

nodes.label: MC1R
nodes.description: Melanocortin 1 Receptor; GPCR regulating eumelanin vs pheomelanin switching; loss-of-function variants linked to red hair, melanoma risk, and increased Parkinson's Disease risk

nodes.label: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase
nodes.description: AADC/DOPA decarboxylase; converts L-DOPA to dopamine; penultimate step in catecholamine biosynthesis; target of carbidopa in PD therapy
nodes.id: notes/neuromelanin/Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase.md/Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase

nodes.label: Monoamine oxidase B
nodes.description: Flavin-dependent outer mitochondrial membrane enzyme; catalyzes oxidative deamination of monoamines; bioactivates MPTP to MPP+; activity rises with age increasing oxidative burden

nodes.label: L-DOPA
nodes.description: L-3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine; immediate biosynthetic precursor to dopamine; gold-standard symptomatic treatment for Parkinson's Disease; also substrate for neuromelanin formation

nodes.label: Lewy Bodies
nodes.description: Intracytoplasmic proteinaceous inclusions defining synucleinopathies; composed mainly of phosphorylated alpha-synuclein; frequently adjacent to or enveloping neuromelanin granules

nodes.label: Pale Bodies
nodes.description: Early faintly eosinophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions considered precursor structures to Lewy Bodies; intimately associated with neuromelanin granules in SNpc neurons

nodes.label: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation
nodes.description: Process by which soluble alpha-synuclein monomers misfold into oligomers, protofibrils, and insoluble fibrils; principal component of Lewy Bodies; central driver of neuronal dysfunction in PD

nodes.label: Incidental Lewy Body Disease
nodes.description: Presymptomatic/preclinical PD stage with Lewy Bodies and alpha-synuclein pathology without clinical signs; elevated neuromelanin above pathogenic threshold supports pigment-driven vulnerability
nodes.id: notes/neuromelanin/Incidental Lewy Body Disease.md/Incidental Lewy Body Disease

nodes.label: A53T
nodes.description: Missense mutation in SNCA gene (alanine to threonine at position 53); autosomal-dominant cause of early-onset familial Parkinson's Disease; accelerates alpha-synuclein aggregation

nodes.label: 6-hydroxydopamine
nodes.description: Hydroxylated dopamine analogue neurotoxin selectively destroying catecholaminergic neurons via ROS generation and mitochondrial inhibition; widely used in PD animal models

nodes.label: MPTP
nodes.description: Lipophilic piperidine prodrug crossing blood-brain barrier; converted by MAO-B to MPP+; selectively destroys dopaminergic neurons; definitive PD modeling tool

nodes.label: MPP+
nodes.description: 1-methyl-4-phenylpyridinium; active toxic metabolite of MPTP; inhibits mitochondrial Complex I; selectively destroys neuromelanin-containing dopaminergic neurons

nodes.label: Neurotoxin
nodes.description: Substance disrupting nervous system structure or function; in PD research includes MPP+, 6-OHDA, paraquat, rotenone; selectively targets neuromelanin-containing catecholaminergic neurons

nodes.label: HPP+
nodes.description: Toxic pyridinium metabolite of haloperidol; structurally analogous to MPP+; inhibits Complex I; selectively targets neuromelanin neurons via dopamine transporter

nodes.label: Haloperidol
nodes.description: First-generation antipsychotic; D2 receptor antagonist; metabolized to HPP+ neurotoxin; can induce drug-induced parkinsonism through mitochondrial toxicity

nodes.label: DJ-1
nodes.description: PARK7-encoded multifunctional protein; oxidative stress sensor, redox-regulated chaperone preventing alpha-synuclein aggregation, transcriptional coactivator; loss-of-function causes early-onset recessive PD

nodes.label: Glucocerebrosidase
nodes.description: Lysosomal hydrolase encoded by GBA1; cleaves glucosylceramide; GBA1 mutations are the most common genetic PD risk factor; impaired GCase promotes alpha-synuclein aggregation

nodes.label: Ambroxol
nodes.description: Mucolytic drug repurposed as pharmacological chaperone for glucocerebrosidase; stabilizes GBA promoting proper trafficking; candidate disease-modifying therapy for PD

nodes.label: Vesicular Monoamine Transporter 2
nodes.description: VMAT2; vacuolar membrane transporter packaging monoamines into synaptic vesicles; limits cytosolic dopamine preventing quinone formation and neuromelanin accrual; key determinant of neuronal resilience

nodes.label: Neurotransmission
nodes.description: Process of presynaptic neurotransmitter release, diffusion across synapse, and postsynaptic receptor binding; catecholaminergic transmission fuels neuromelanin formation through dopamine oxidation

nodes.label: Synaptic plasticity
nodes.description: Activity-dependent strengthening/weakening of synapses; modulated by dopamine from neuromelanin-bearing SNpc neurons; impaired in Parkinson's Disease

nodes.label: Synapse
nodes.description: Specialized junction between neurons for communication; dopaminergic synapse of nigrostriatal system central to motor control; progressively lost in PD

nodes.label: Synaptic Vesicles
nodes.description: Presynaptic organelles storing and releasing neurotransmitters via exocytosis; VMAT2 packages dopamine into vesicles limiting cytosolic oxidation and neuromelanin formation

nodes.label: Neuronophagia
nodes.description: Pathological process where activated microglia phagocytize degenerating neurons; triggered by extracellular neuromelanin release; histological hallmark of active PD neurodegeneration

nodes.label: Microgliosis
nodes.description: Activation and proliferation of microglia; cardinal element of neuroinflammation in PD; triggered by extracellular neuromelanin and aggregated alpha-synuclein

nodes.label: Glial cells
nodes.description: Non-neuronal CNS supporting cells including astrocytes and microglia; astrocytes express MAO-B converting MPTP to MPP+; microglia mediate neuroinflammation in PD

nodes.label: Lymphocytes
nodes.description: Adaptive immune cells including B cells, T cells; infiltrate substantia nigra in PD; may target neuromelanin neurons via MHC-I antigen presentation

nodes.label: Antigen Presentation
nodes.description: Process displaying peptide fragments on MHC molecules for T cell surveillance; aberrant neuronal MHC-I upregulation in PD may render neuromelanin neurons targets for cytotoxic T cells

nodes.label: Major histocompatibility complex class I
nodes.description: Cell-surface glycoproteins presenting intracellular peptides to CD8+ T cells; upregulated on neuromelanin-containing neurons in PD linking pigment to adaptive immune vulnerability
nodes.id: notes/neuromelanin/Major histocompatibility complex class I.md/Major histocompatibility complex class I

nodes.label: Immunoglobulin G
nodes.description: Most abundant antibody class; deposits found within neuromelanin-containing neurons in PD substantia nigra and locus coeruleus; implicates adaptive humoral immunity in PD

nodes.label: Bradykinesia
nodes.description: Slowness of movement initiation and execution; cardinal motor symptom of PD; reflects loss of dopaminergic input from SNpc to striatum

nodes.label: Hypokinesia
nodes.description: Reduced amount and speed of voluntary movement; cardinal motor feature of PD arising from basal ganglia circuit dysfunction due to loss of nigral dopamine

nodes.label: Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin
nodes.description: Hypothesized intracellular neuromelanin level above which pigment converts from protective sink to driver of oxidative stress, proteostasis collapse, and neurodegeneration
nodes.id: notes/neuromelanin/Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin.md/Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin

nodes.label: Chemical memory
nodes.description: Hypothesized form of intracellular molecular memory where neuromelanin granules store and release dopamine on demand, encoding biochemical trace of prior activity

nodes.label: Addiction
nodes.description: Chronic relapsing disorder of compulsive drug seeking; involves mesolimbic and nigrostriatal dopaminergic pathways; linked to PD through shared dopamine neurobiology

nodes.label: Nicotine
nodes.description: Alkaloid nicotine acetylcholine receptor agonist; binds neuromelanin; epidemiological studies associate smoking with 30-60% reduced PD risk

nodes.label: Lysosomal Exocytosis
nodes.description: Regulated secretion pathway exporting undegradable lysosomal cargo (including neuromelanin) to extracellular space; last-resort clearance mechanism for non-degradable pigment

nodes.label: Manganism
nodes.description: Neurological disorder from chronic manganese exposure; motor symptoms resembling PD but lacking Lewy bodies; manganese binds neuromelanin generating oxidative stress

nodes.label: Magnetic Resonance Imaging
nodes.description: Non-invasive imaging using paramagnetic T1-shortening of neuromelanin-bound metals to visualize pigment-rich brainstem nuclei in vivo

nodes.label: Positron Emission Tomography
nodes.description: Functional molecular imaging using radiotracers to quantify dopaminergic integrity; presynaptic tracers index loss of neuromelanin-containing SNpc neurons

nodes.label: Flortaucipir
nodes.description: [18F]-AV-1451 tau PET tracer with off-target high-affinity binding to neuromelanin; used to visualize neuromelanin-containing brainstem nuclei non-invasively

nodes.label: Macromolecular Crowding
nodes.description: Cytoplasmic excluded-volume effect amplified by insoluble neuromelanin and lipofuscin accumulation; promotes alpha-synuclein aggregation and impairs proteostasis

nodes.label: Dolichol
nodes.description: Long-chain polyisoprenoid lipid; major lipid component of neuromelanin granules; influences granule membrane properties and stability

nodes.label: Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff
nodes.description: Russian-born neuroanatomist who first reported loss of pigmented substantia nigra neurons as cardinal pathologic feature of Parkinson's Disease (1919)

nodes.label: Lipofuscin
nodes.description: Brownish-yellow autofluorescent aging pigment from incomplete lysosomal digestion; broadly accumulates in post-mitotic cells; contrasts with neuromelanin in origin and distribution

nodes.label: Oculocutaneous Albinism
nodes.description: Autosomal recessive disorders of melanin biosynthesis from defects in tyrosinase or melanosomal proteins; types OCA1-7 with variable hypopigmentation

nodes.label: Cutaneous Melanoma
nodes.description: Aggressive skin cancer from melanocytes; reciprocally associated with Parkinson's Disease epidemiologically; shares melanogenesis enzyme toolkit with neuromelanin neurons

nodes.label: Substantia Nigra
nodes.description: Midbrain nucleus named for dark appearance from neuromelanin; contains SNpc with pigmented dopaminergic neurons; primary site of pathology in Parkinson's Disease

nodes.label: Alpha-synuclein
nodes.description: Presynaptic protein regulating SNARE complex and vesicle cycling; misfolds and aggregates into Lewy Bodies; primary constituent of PD pathology

nodes.label: Tyrosinase
nodes.description: Rate-limiting copper-containing enzyme initiating melanogenesis; hydroxylates tyrosine to L-DOPA and oxidizes to dopaquinone; links peripheral melanin to neuromelanin pathway

nodes.label: Iron
nodes.description: Redox-active transition metal bound by neuromelanin with high affinity; drives Fenton chemistry generating ROS; accumulates in neuromelanin granules with age

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Dysfunction
nodes.description: Impaired mitochondrial respiration (particularly Complex I deficiency); coupled to proteostatic failure and ROS escalation; central to selective vulnerability of pigmented neurons

nodes.label: Lysosomal Dysfunction
nodes.description: Impaired lysosomal degradation and autophagic flux; worsened by neuromelanin overload; linked to GBA1 deficiency and alpha-synuclein accumulation in PD

nodes.label: Neuroinflammation
nodes.description: Chronic inflammatory response involving microglial and astroglial activation; triggered by extracellular neuromelanin release; contributes to progressive neurodegeneration in PD

nodes.label: Proteostasis
nodes.description: Protein homeostasis network including autophagy and ubiquitin-proteasome system; collapses when neuromelanin exceeds pathogenic threshold allowing misfolded protein accumulation

nodes.label: Reactive Oxygen Species
nodes.description: Chemically reactive oxygen-containing molecules; generated by dopamine redox cycling, MAO-B activity, and Fenton chemistry; damage cellular components in pigmented neurons

nodes.label: Tyrosine Hydroxylase
nodes.description: Rate-limiting enzyme in catecholamine biosynthesis; hydroxylates L-tyrosine to L-DOPA; requires tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor

nodes.label: Aminochromes
nodes.description: Cyclized oxidative intermediates of catecholamines (e.g., dopaminochrome, adrenochrome); polymerize into neuromelanin; toxic when not sequestered

nodes.label: Complex I
nodes.description: NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase of mitochondrial electron transport chain; inhibited by MPP+, 6-OHDA, and rotenone; defective in PD substantia nigra

nodes.label: Ubiquitin
nodes.description: Small regulatory protein tagging proteins for proteasomal degradation; co-deposited in Lewy Bodies and Pale Bodies reflecting failed proteostasis

nodes.label: Neuroprotection
nodes.description: Therapeutic strategies preserving neuronal function and survival; includes MAO-B inhibitors, MC1R agonists, ambroxol, and lysosomal exocytosis enhancement in PD

nodes.label: Manganese
nodes.description: Trace metal accumulating in basal ganglia; causes manganism; binds neuromelanin with high affinity; inhibits mitochondrial Complex II generating oxidative stress

nodes.label: Deep Brain Stimulation
nodes.description: Surgical therapy implanting electrodes in subthalamic nucleus or globus pallidus internus; restores basal ganglia circuit balance; used in advanced PD

nodes.label: Cytokines
nodes.description: Cell-signaling proteins mediating inflammation; released by activated microglia in PD; induce MHC-I expression on neurons contributing to antigen presentation

nodes.label: Caspase-2
nodes.description: Initiator caspase regulated by phosphorylation at Ser308 by CDK1/CYCLIN B1, Ser164 by CaMKII/PP1, and Ser157 by CK2

nodes.label: Caspase-3
nodes.description: Primary executioner caspase that cleaves PARP1, ICAD, Lamins, Gelsolin, and ROCK1; activated by Caspase-8, Caspase-9, and Caspase-10

nodes.label: Caspase-6
nodes.description: Executioner caspase specialized in cleaving nuclear lamin A to drive nuclear disassembly; provides backup execution route when Caspase-3 is inhibited

nodes.label: Caspase-7
nodes.description: Executioner caspase that coordinates with Caspase-3; inhibited by XIAP and PAK2 phosphorylation; relieved by Smac/DIABLO

nodes.label: Caspase-9
nodes.description: Primary initiator caspase of the intrinsic pathway; activated by the Apoptosome complex; inhibited by XIAP and phosphorylation by Akt, PKA, CDK1, DYRK1A, ERK, p38 MAPK

nodes.label: Caspase-10
nodes.description: Initiator caspase closely related to Caspase-8; activated at DISC downstream of Fas, DR4, DR5; activates executioner caspases and processes Bid

nodes.label: DISC
nodes.description: Death-Inducing Signaling Complex; multi-protein assembly forming at death receptor tails; recruits FADD and pro-Caspase-8/10 for proximity-induced auto-activation

nodes.label: FADD
nodes.description: Fas-associated via death domain adaptor protein bridging death receptors (Fas, TNFR1, DR4, DR5) to initiator caspases via DD and DED interactions

nodes.label: XIAP
nodes.description: X-linked Inhibitor of Apoptosis Protein (BIRC4); most potent IAP; directly inhibits Caspase-3, Caspase-7, and Caspase-9; regulated by Akt, TBK1/IKKε, and Smac-DIABLO

nodes.label: Bim
nodes.description: Bcl-2-like protein 11; potent pro-apoptotic BH3-only protein; directly activates Bax/Bak and neutralizes Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1; degraded via ERK/RSK/SCF-Beta-TrCP axis

nodes.label: Bad
nodes.description: Bcl-2-associated death promoter; BH3-only sensor of growth factor signaling; binds and neutralizes Bcl-xL and Bcl-w when dephosphorylated; inhibited by Akt, PAK1, IKK, PKA phosphorylation

nodes.label: Puma
nodes.description: p53 upregulated modulator of apoptosis (BBC3); major transcriptional target of p53; neutralizes Bcl-2/Bcl-xL and activates Bax/Bak to trigger intrinsic pathway

nodes.label: BH3 Profiling
nodes.description: Functional assay developed by Anthony Letai that measures mitochondrial apoptotic priming; uses synthetic BH3 peptides to determine dependence on specific anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins

nodes.label: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins
nodes.description: Family of eight endogenous caspase inhibitors (NAIP, c-IAP1, c-IAP2, XIAP, Survivin, Apollon, Livin, IAP-like protein 2); bind active sites of caspases and promote their degradation
nodes.id: notes/cancer/Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins.md/Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins

nodes.label: Smac/DIABLO
nodes.description: Second mitochondria-derived activator of caspases; released during MOMP; binds IAP BIR domains to neutralize XIAP, Survivin, c-IAP1/2; relieves caspase inhibition

nodes.label: A1/Bfl-1
nodes.description: Bcl-2-related protein A1; anti-apoptotic member induced by NFκB and STAT3; sequesters BH3-only proteins and Bax/Bak; confers resistance to BH3 mimetics

nodes.label: PIDDosome
nodes.description: Multi-protein complex of PIDD and RAIDD that activates Caspase-2 in response to genotoxic stress and mitotic catastrophe; links DNA damage to apoptosis

nodes.label: Common Pathway
nodes.description: Execution phase of apoptosis where intrinsic and extrinsic pathways converge; characterized by activation of executioner caspases 3, 6, 7

nodes.label: Tumorigenesis
nodes.description: Multi-step process of normal cells transforming into malignant cells through Initiation, Promotion, and Progression stages; acquisition of Hallmarks of Cancer

nodes.label: Cancer Stem Cells
nodes.description: Subpopulation of tumor cells with self-renewal and differentiation capacity; marked by Nanog, Oct4, Sox2; cause recurrence, metastasis, therapy resistance

nodes.label: EMT
nodes.description: Epithelial-mesenchymal transition; program where epithelial cells lose adhesion and polarity, acquire mesenchymal invasiveness; driven by Snail, Slug, ZEB1/2, Twist

nodes.label: Metabolic Reprogramming
nodes.description: Hallmark of cancer where cells alter metabolism for proliferation; includes Warburg effect (aerobic glycolysis), enhanced glutaminolysis, altered lipid metabolism

nodes.label: Wnt
nodes.description: Conserved signaling pathway; canonical Wnt/β-catenin controls gene transcription via β-catenin/TCF; dysregulated in colorectal, breast, and other cancers

nodes.label: JNK
nodes.description: c-Jun N-terminal kinase; stress-activated MAPK that phosphorylates Bim and Mcl-1; dual role in cancer-tumor suppression via death induction or promotion via survival signaling

nodes.label: ERK1/2
nodes.description: Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 1/2; terminal effectors of RAS-RAF-MEK MAPK cascade; phosphorylate Bim for degradation, stabilize Mcl-1; drive proliferation

nodes.label: RAF1
nodes.description: C-Raf serine/threonine kinase; core MAPK/ERK pathway component; phosphorylates and inactivates Bad at Ser112 to promote survival; relays signals from Ras to MEK

nodes.label: FOXO Transcription Factors
nodes.description: Forkhead box O family (FOXO1, FOXO3, FOXO4, FOXO6); master regulators of stress response; induce Bim, Puma, p27, MnSOD; inhibited by PI3K/Akt phosphorylation

nodes.label: BET Inhibitors
nodes.description: Epigenetic drugs targeting bromodomains of BRD2/3/4/BRDT; displace BET proteins from chromatin; downregulate MYC and suppress SASP; senomorphic agents

nodes.label: CKII
nodes.description: Casein kinase 2 (CK2); constitutively active serine/threonine kinase phosphorylating >300 substrates; stabilizes Mcl-1, inhibits Bid and Caspase-2; overexpressed in cancer

nodes.label: PP1α
nodes.description: Protein phosphatase 1 alpha (PPP1CA); dephosphorylates and activates Caspase-9 by removing inhibitory phosphate at Thr125; promotes intrinsic apoptosis

nodes.label: SCF Complex
nodes.description: Skp1-Cul1-F-box E3 ubiquitin ligase; targets phosphorylated substrates (Mcl-1, Bim) for proteasomal degradation; regulates apoptosis and cell-cycle checkpoints

nodes.label: Beta-TrCP
nodes.description: F-box substrate-recognition subunit of SCF E3 ligase; recognizes phosphorylated DSGXXS degron; targets Mcl-1, IκBα, β-catenin for proteasomal degradation

nodes.label: Apoptosis
nodes.description: Programmed cell death executed by caspase cascade; intrinsic (mitochondrial) and extrinsic (death receptor) pathways converge on executioner caspases

nodes.label: Intrinsic Pathway
nodes.description: Mitochondrial pathway of apoptosis triggered by MOMP, cytochrome c release, Apoptosome formation, and Caspase-9 activation

nodes.label: Extrinsic Pathway
nodes.description: Death receptor pathway of apoptosis initiated by ligand binding to Fas, TNFR1, TRAIL-R1/R2; DISC formation activates Caspase-8/10

nodes.label: NF-κB
nodes.description: Nuclear factor kappa B; transcription factor driving inflammation and survival; induces A1/Bfl-1; activated by IκBα degradation via Beta-TrCP

nodes.label: Mcl-1
nodes.description: Anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein; stabilized by CKII and ERK1/2; degraded by SCF-Beta-TrCP; resistance factor for BH3 mimetics

nodes.label: Bcl-2
nodes.description: Anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein; neutralized by Bim, Bad, Puma; target of venetoclax; dependence detected by BH3 profiling

nodes.label: Bcl-xL
nodes.description: Anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein; primary target of Bad; target of navitoclax; dependence in platelets causes thrombocytopenia

nodes.label: Bax
nodes.description: Pro-apoptotic multidomain Bcl-2 effector; activated by Bim and Puma; oligomerizes on mitochondrial membrane to trigger MOMP

nodes.label: Bak
nodes.description: Pro-apoptotic multidomain Bcl-2 effector; activated by Bim and Puma; oligomerizes on mitochondrial membrane to trigger MOMP

nodes.label: MOMP
nodes.description: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization; commitment step of intrinsic apoptosis; releases cytochrome c and Smac/DIABLO

nodes.label: Cytochrome c
nodes.description: Mitochondrial protein released during MOMP; binds Apaf-1 to form Apoptosome and activate Caspase-9

nodes.label: Apaf-1
nodes.description: Apoptotic protease activating factor 1; core component of the Apoptosome complex that activates Caspase-9

nodes.label: Apoptosome
nodes.description: Multi-protein complex of cytochrome c, Apaf-1, and pro-Caspase-9 that activates the intrinsic apoptosis pathway

nodes.label: BH3 Mimetics
nodes.description: Drugs mimicking BH3-only proteins to inhibit anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family; include venetoclax (Bcl-2), navitoclax (Bcl-xL/Bcl-2), Mcl-1 inhibitors

nodes.label: Hallmarks of Cancer
nodes.description: Framework describing the capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis: sustained proliferation, apoptosis evasion, invasion/metastasis, metabolic reprogramming, immune evasion, etc.

nodes.label: Metastasis
nodes.description: Spread of cancer cells from primary site to distant organs; driven by EMT, TME remodeling, and survival in circulation

nodes.label: Chemotherapy
nodes.description: Cytotoxic drug treatment for cancer; efficacy limited by apoptotic resistance; often combined with targeted agents to sensitize cells

nodes.label: Ivermectin
nodes.description: Antiparasitic drug repurposed for anticancer effects; inhibits Wnt/β-catenin, EMT, and Cancer Stem Cells; targets PAK1-STAT3 axis

nodes.label: Ubiquitination
nodes.description: Post-translational modification targeting proteins for proteasomal degradation; mediated by E3 ligases including SCF Complex and Beta-TrCP

nodes.label: Phosphorylation
nodes.description: Reversible post-translational modification regulating protein activity; key mechanism for caspase regulation and kinase signaling

nodes.label: MEK
nodes.description: MAPK/ERK kinase; activated by RAF; phosphorylates and activates ERK1/2; target of approved inhibitors

nodes.label: GSK3β
nodes.description: Glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta; phosphorylates Mcl-1 and β-catenin to prime for SCF-Beta-TrCP-mediated degradation

nodes.label: PAK1
nodes.description: p21-activated kinase 1; phosphorylates Bad; regulatory kinase for CSC formation via STAT3; facilitates Wnt/β-catenin signaling

nodes.label: CDK1
nodes.description: Cyclin-dependent kinase 1; phosphorylates Caspase-2 at Ser308 with CYCLIN B1; phosphorylates Caspase-9 at Thr125 to suppress activity

nodes.label: Bid
nodes.description: BH3-only protein linking extrinsic to intrinsic pathway; cleaved by Caspase-8/10 to form tBid; substrate of Caspase-2 and CKII

nodes.label: Hypoxia
nodes.description: Low oxygen condition within TME; drives angiogenesis, metabolic reprogramming, immune evasion, and therapy resistance

nodes.label: Angiogenesis
nodes.description: Formation of new blood vessels from existing vasculature; driven by VEGF in TME; hallmark of cancer

nodes.label: Inflammation
nodes.description: Complex biological response to harmful stimuli; chronic inflammation promotes tumorigenesis; JNK and NF-κB are key mediators

nodes.label: Warburg Effect
nodes.description: Aerobic glycolysis; hallmark of metabolic reprogramming where cancer cells prefer glycolysis even with oxygen present

nodes.label: EGFR
nodes.description: Epidermal growth factor receptor; receptor tyrosine kinase activating RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK pathway; frequently overexpressed or mutated in cancer

nodes.label: PARP1
nodes.description: DNA repair enzyme cleaved by Caspase-3 at DEVD motif; cleavage inactivates DNA repair conserving ATP for apoptosis

nodes.label: TRAIL
nodes.description: TNF-related apoptosis-inducing ligand; binds DR4/DR5 to activate extrinsic pathway through DISC; synergizes with Smac mimetics

nodes.label: ICAD
nodes.description: Inhibitor of caspase-activated DNase; cleaved by Caspase-3 to release CAD for DNA fragmentation

nodes.label: PI3K
nodes.description: Phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase; upstream activator of Akt; phosphorylates PIP2 to PIP3; FOXO regulation pathway

nodes.label: ERK
nodes.description: Extracellular signal-regulated kinase; phosphorylates Bim for proteasomal degradation; phosphorylates Caspase-9 at Thr125 to suppress apoptosis

nodes.label: Proteasome
nodes.description: Proteolytic complex for degrading ubiquitinated proteins; target of SCF/Beta-TrCP-mediated degradation; regulates Mcl-1 and Bim turnover

nodes.label: Immunotherapy
nodes.description: Cancer treatment that harnesses immune system; checkpoint inhibitors (anti-PD-1, anti-CTLA-4) modulate immune cells in TME

nodes.label: Smac Mimetics
nodes.description: Small molecules mimicking Smac/DIABLO to neutralize IAPs; sensitize tumor cells to apoptosis; synergize with TRAIL

nodes.label: VEGF
nodes.description: Vascular endothelial growth factor; primary driver of angiogenesis in TME; target of anti-angiogenic therapy

nodes.label: STAT3
nodes.description: Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3; transcription factor downstream of PAK1 in CSC regulation; induces A1/Bfl-1

nodes.label: Fas
nodes.description: Death receptor (CD95) that binds FasL; recruits FADD to form DISC; activates extrinsic apoptosis via Caspase-8/10

nodes.label: DR4
nodes.description: TRAIL receptor 1 (TRAIL-R1); death receptor that recruits FADD and DISC for extrinsic apoptosis

nodes.label: DR5
nodes.description: TRAIL receptor 2 (TRAIL-R2); death receptor that recruits FADD and DISC for extrinsic apoptosis

nodes.label: TNFR1
nodes.description: TNF receptor 1; death receptor that recruits TRADD/FADD for DISC formation and NF-κB activation

nodes.label: Survivin
nodes.description: BIRC5; IAP family member that also regulates cell cycle; overexpressed in many cancers; neutralized by Smac/DIABLO

nodes.label: Senescence
nodes.description: Stable cell-cycle arrest; acts as barrier to tumorigenesis; SASP from senescent cells can paradoxically promote cancer

nodes.label: BRD4
nodes.description: Bromodomain-containing protein 4; binds acetylated histones at super-enhancers; regulates MYC transcription; target of BET inhibitors

nodes.label: HIF-1α
nodes.description: Hypoxia-inducible factor 1 alpha; master regulator of hypoxic response; drives metabolic reprogramming and angiogenesis

nodes.label: PLK1
nodes.description: Polo-like kinase 1; master regulator of mitosis; phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser62; overexpressed in cancers

nodes.label: PLK3
nodes.description: Stress-responsive Polo-like kinase; phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser49 and p53; tumor suppressor

nodes.label: Polo-box domain
nodes.description: C-terminal phospho-peptide binding domain in Polo-like kinases directing subcellular localization

nodes.label: Aurora A
nodes.description: Mitotic kinase that cooperates with Bora to activate PLK1

nodes.label: Polo-like kinase
nodes.description: Family of serine/threonine kinases including PLK1 (oncogenic) and PLK3 (tumor suppressive)

nodes.label: CYCLIN B1
nodes.description: Regulatory subunit of CDK1 forming MPF; drives G2/M transition; phosphorylates Caspase-2 at Ser308

nodes.label: Caspase-2
nodes.description: Initiator caspase phosphorylated at Ser308 by CDK1/Cyclin B1, suppressing apoptosis during mitosis

nodes.label: BRCA
nodes.description: Breast Cancer gene; BRCA1 and BRCA2 tumor suppressors essential for homologous recombination DNA repair

nodes.label: MLL1
nodes.description: Histone methyltransferase catalyzing H3K4me3; master regulator of HOX genes; rearranged in leukemia

nodes.label: Menin
nodes.description: Critical co-factor recruiting MLL1 to chromatin; target of menin inhibitors in MLL-rearranged leukemia

nodes.label: Leukemia
nodes.description: Hematopoietic malignancy driven by MLL rearrangements and other oncogenic lesions

nodes.label: HOX genes
nodes.description: Key transcriptional targets of MLL1 regulating development and hematopoiesis

nodes.label: HER2
nodes.description: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2; ErbB2; amplified in breast cancer; target of trastuzumab and melittin

nodes.label: trastuzumab
nodes.description: Anti-HER2 monoclonal antibody used in HER2+ breast and gastric cancers

nodes.label: PAK2
nodes.description: p21-activated kinase 2; Rac/Cdc42 effector; bifunctional survival/apoptosis regulator; phosphorylates Caspase-7

nodes.label: Caspase-7
nodes.description: Effector caspase phosphorylated by PAK2 at Ser30/Thr173/Ser239 to suppress apoptosis

nodes.label: PAK4
nodes.description: Group II p21-activated kinase; phosphorylates Bad, Raf, β-catenin; overexpressed in many cancers

nodes.label: Bad
nodes.description: Pro-apoptotic BH3-only protein inactivated by phosphorylation at Ser112 by PAK1/4/5, PKA, PKCι, RAF1, RSK

nodes.label: Raf
nodes.description: MAP3K kinase activated by PAK4; drives RAF/MEK/ERK proliferation cascade

nodes.label: Trim17
nodes.description: E3 ubiquitin ligase targeting Mcl-1 for proteasomal degradation; promotes apoptosis

nodes.label: LYN
nodes.description: Src-family non-receptor tyrosine kinase; phosphorylates Caspase-8 at Tyr397/Tyr465 suppressing apoptosis

nodes.label: Caspase-8
nodes.description: Initiator caspase in extrinsic apoptosis; suppressed by LYN phosphorylation; de-repressed by SHP1

nodes.label: SHP1
nodes.description: Tyrosine phosphatase that dephosphorylates and activates Caspase-8 opposing LYN

nodes.label: IKKε
nodes.description: Non-canonical IKK family kinase; phosphorylates XIAP triggering its degradation; antiviral and oncogenic signaling

nodes.label: XIAP
nodes.description: X-linked inhibitor of apoptosis protein; potent caspase inhibitor degraded upon IKKε phosphorylation

nodes.label: TBK1
nodes.description: IKKε paralog; shares overlapping substrates in type I IFN response and oncogenic signaling

nodes.label: PKCδ
nodes.description: Novel PKC isoform; pro-apoptotic kinase; cleaved by Caspase-3 in feed-forward loop; phosphorylates FOXO and p38

nodes.label: Caspase-3
nodes.description: Executioner caspase that both cleaves PKCδ and is phosphorylated by PKCδ; central to apoptosis

nodes.label: Protein Kinase C
nodes.description: Family of serine/threonine kinases including conventional, novel, and atypical isoforms

nodes.label: PKCζ
nodes.description: Atypical PKC isoform; activates NF-κB; phosphorylates and inhibits Caspase-9 and Bax; promotes survival

nodes.label: Caspase-9
nodes.description: Initiator caspase in mitochondrial apoptosis; inhibited by PKCζ phosphorylation at Ser144

nodes.label: PKCι
nodes.description: Atypical PKC isoform; candidate oncogene; phosphorylates and inactivates Bad; activates NF-κB

nodes.label: Integrins
nodes.description: α/β heterodimeric transmembrane adhesion receptors; mediate cell-ECM adhesion; drive angiogenesis and metastasis

nodes.label: ECM
nodes.description: Extracellular matrix; ligands for integrins including fibronectin, collagen, laminin

nodes.label: FAK
nodes.description: Focal adhesion kinase; core downstream effector of integrin clustering

nodes.label: CendR motif
nodes.description: C-end Rule motif (R/KXXR/K) binding Neuropilin-1 to trigger transcytosis and deep tumor penetration

nodes.label: Neuropilin-1
nodes.description: VEGF and semaphorin co-receptor; binds CendR motif; mediates tumor angiogenesis and peptide-guided drug delivery

nodes.label: RGD peptide
nodes.description: Arginine-Glycine-Aspartate motif; minimal integrin-binding sequence used in tumor targeting

nodes.label: TAT
nodes.description: HIV-1 transactivator of transcription; basic domain used as cell-penetrating peptide for anticancer cargo delivery

nodes.label: Cell-Penetrating Peptide
nodes.description: Short cationic peptides capable of ferrying cargoes across plasma membrane; TAT is prototypical

nodes.label: ALIX
nodes.description: ESCRT-associated adaptor; controls exosome biogenesis; regulates EGFR and PD-L1 surface levels

nodes.label: PD-L1
nodes.description: Immune checkpoint ligand; secreted via ALIX-dependent exosomes; retained on surface when ALIX is lost

nodes.label: Exosomes
nodes.description: Extracellular vesicles mediating intercellular communication; ALIX-dependent biogenesis

nodes.label: DAMP
nodes.description: Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns; endogenous danger signals released from stressed/dying cells

nodes.label: cGAS-STING Pathway
nodes.description: Cytosolic DNA sensing pathway; drives SASP expression; links senescence to immune surveillance

nodes.label: Prostaglandin E2
nodes.description: Bioactive lipid from COX-2; key SASP component; immunosuppressive in cancer via MDSC recruitment

nodes.label: COX-2
nodes.description: Cyclooxygenase-2; rate-limiting enzyme for PGE2 synthesis; upregulated in senescent hepatic stellate cells

nodes.label: Hepatic Stellate Cells
nodes.description: Liver pericytes; when senescent produce SASP factors driving obesity-associated HCC

nodes.label: GABA
nodes.description: Gamma-aminobutyric acid; chief inhibitory neurotransmitter; ivermectin's primary target clarified as GluCls not GABA receptors

nodes.label: Pyruvate Kinase M2
nodes.description: PKM2; Warburg effect enzyme; dimeric form diverts glycolytic intermediates to biosynthesis; nuclear co-activator

nodes.label: CYP2J2
nodes.description: Cytochrome P450; converts arachidonic acid to EETs; metabolizes benzimidazole anthelmintics

nodes.label: Arachidonic acid
nodes.description: Polyunsaturated fatty acid; precursor of EETs via CYP2J2 and prostaglandins via COX-2

nodes.label: Bmi-1
nodes.description: Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 component; oncogene regulating stemness and apoptosis evasion

nodes.label: Cancer Stem Cells
nodes.description: Self-renewing tumor subpopulation maintained by Bmi-1; targeted by ivermectin via PAK1-STAT3 axis

nodes.label: USP9X
nodes.description: Deubiquitinase stabilizing Mcl-1 by removing polyubiquitin chains; overexpressed in many cancers

nodes.label: ABT-263
nodes.description: Navitoclax; second-generation BH3 mimetic targeting Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Bcl-w; causes thrombocytopenia via Bcl-xL inhibition

nodes.label: Oblimersen sodium
nodes.description: Bcl-2-targeting antisense oligonucleotide; first Bcl-2-directed agent in clinical trials

nodes.label: Irinotecan
nodes.description: Camptothecin prodrug; topoisomerase I poison; converted to SN-38; cornerstone of colorectal cancer therapy

nodes.label: DNA Topoisomerase I
nodes.description: Enzyme relieving DNA torsional stress; target of irinotecan/SN-38

nodes.label: Cilengitide
nodes.description: Cyclic RGD pentapeptide; αvβ3/αvβ5 integrin antagonist; anti-angiogenic agent tested in glioblastoma

nodes.label: Honeybee
nodes.description: Apis mellifera; source of venom containing melittin with broad anticancer activity

nodes.label: Honeybee venom
nodes.description: Apitoxin; complex mixture of melittin, phospholipase A2, and other peptides with anticancer properties

nodes.label: melittin
nodes.description: 26-aa amphipathic peptide; 50% of bee venom dry weight; forms membrane pores; inhibits EGFR/HER2; synergizes with chemotherapy

nodes.label: apitherapy
nodes.description: Alternative medicine using honeybee products; melittin and propolis investigated for anticancer effects

nodes.label: Fenbendazole
nodes.description: Benzimidazole anthelmintic; microtubule destabilizer; suppresses glycolysis; induces ROS/p53; repurposed for cancer

nodes.label: Mebendazole
nodes.description: Benzimidazole anthelmintic; tubulin-binding microtubule disruptor; inhibits Hedgehog/Wnt/NFκB; repurposed in glioblastoma

nodes.label: Ivermectin
nodes.description: Macrolide antiparasitic; PAK1 inhibitor; anticancer via YAP1/Akt/mTOR/Wnt inhibition; induces apoptosis/autophagy/pyroptosis

nodes.label: Avermectin
nodes.description: 16-membered macrocyclic lactone from Streptomyces avermectinius; parent compound of ivermectin

nodes.label: YAP1
nodes.description: Hippo pathway effector; inhibited by ivermectin; drives proliferation in lung, gastric, and liver cancers

nodes.label: Onchocerciasis
nodes.description: River blindness; filarial infection by Onchocerca volvulus; controlled by ivermectin mass administration

nodes.label: Onchocerciasis Chemotherapy Research Centre
nodes.description: Ghana-based clinical research institute; evaluates anthelmintics including ivermectin and oxfendazole
nodes.id: notes/cancer/Onchocerciasis Chemotherapy Research Centre.md/Onchocerciasis Chemotherapy Research Centre

nodes.label: Ascaris
nodes.description: Genus of large parasitic roundworms; Ascaris lumbricoides causes ascariasis in humans

nodes.label: Ascariasis
nodes.description: Most common helminth infection; caused by Ascaris lumbricoides; treated with albendazole and ivermectin

nodes.label: Brugia malayi
nodes.description: Filarial nematode causing lymphatic filariasis in Southeast Asia; treated with ivermectin/albendazole

nodes.label: Lymphatic Filariasis
nodes.description: Neglected tropical disease caused by W. bancrofti, B. malayi, B. timori; targeted by GPELF

nodes.label: Wuchereria bancrofti
nodes.description: Principal cause of lymphatic filariasis; mosquito-borne filarial nematode

nodes.label: Strongyloides
nodes.description: Parasitic nematode genus; S. stercoralis causes strongyloidiasis with unique autoinfection; risk in immunosuppressed cancer patients

nodes.label: Scabies
nodes.description: Contagious skin infestation by Sarcoptes scabiei mite; treated with permethrin and ivermectin

nodes.label: Leishmaniasis
nodes.description: Vector-borne protozoan disease; three forms: visceral, cutaneous, mucocutaneous; ivermectin investigated

nodes.label: Microfilariae
nodes.description: Motile larval stage of filarial nematodes; cleared by ivermectin and diethylcarbamazine

nodes.label: GlaxoSmithKline
nodes.description: Pharmaceutical company; donates albendazole for LF elimination; develops oncology therapeutics

nodes.label: HIV-1
nodes.description: Human immunodeficiency virus type 1; causes AIDS; TAT protein used as cell-penetrating peptide in anticancer research

nodes.label: Lung Cancer
nodes.description: Leading cause of cancer death; ivermectin inhibits via YAP1, EGFR, EMT, HSP27; cGAS-STING-SASP axis in KRAS-LKB1 mutant

nodes.label: Colon Cancer
nodes.description: Major colorectal malignancy; Vogelstein adenoma-carcinoma sequence; APC/KRAS/SMAD4/TP53 mutations

nodes.label: Gastric Cancer
nodes.description: Stomach cancer; H. pylori-driven; HER2 amplified; ivermectin inhibits YAP1-high models

nodes.label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma
nodes.description: Primary liver cancer; obesity-associated via senescence-SASP-cGAS-STING-HSC axis; ivermectin inhibits YAP1

nodes.label: glioblastoma
nodes.description: Most aggressive primary brain tumor; EGFR amplified; ivermectin induces apoptosis/autophagy; Cilengitide tested

nodes.label: Cervical Cancer
nodes.description: Cervical malignancy; honeybee venom and ivermectin show antitumoral effects

nodes.label: Leukemia
nodes.description: Blood cancers; MLL rearrangements; melittin and ivermectin show cytotoxic activity

nodes.label: Cholangiocarcinoma
nodes.description: Bile duct cancer; ivermectin overcomes gemcitabine resistance; S phase arrest and apoptosis

nodes.label: Glutamate-gated Cl- channels
nodes.description: Invertebrate-specific ligand-gated chloride channels; primary target of ivermectin/ avermectins

nodes.label: Phosphorylation
nodes.description: Reversible covalent addition of phosphate; most abundant post-translational modification regulating signaling cascades

nodes.label: OCP
nodes.description: Onchocerciasis Control Programme in West Africa (1974-2002); landmark vector control and ivermectin MDA campaign

nodes.label: World Health Organization
nodes.description: UN agency coordinating global disease elimination programs including OCP, APOC, GPELF

nodes.label: Merck & Co. Inc
nodes.description: Pharmaceutical company; discovered and donated ivermectin (Mectizan) for onchocerciasis control

nodes.label: Oncogene
nodes.description: Genes with potential to cause cancer when mutated or overexpressed; PKCι is candidate oncogene

nodes.label: EMT
nodes.description: Epithelial-mesenchymal transition; invasive program promoted by IKKε, PKCι, integrins; inhibited by ivermectin

nodes.label: Drug Repositioning
nodes.description: Strategy of using approved drugs for new indications; applied to ivermectin, fenbendazole, mebendazole

nodes.label: SQSTM1
nodes.description: p62; scaffold protein interacting with atypical PKCs (PKCι, PKCζ) via PB1 domain

nodes.label: MAPK
nodes.description: Mitogen-activated protein kinase cascade; regulated by PAK4/Raf; targeted by ivermectin and mebendazole

nodes.label: Albendazole
nodes.description: Benzimidazole anthelmintic; tubulin binder; metabolized by CYP2J2; donated by GSK for LF elimination

nodes.label: Microtubule
nodes.description: Cytoskeletal polymer; target of benzimidazoles (fenbendazole, mebendazole) and taxanes

nodes.label: Tubulin
nodes.description: Microtubule subunit; bound by mebendazole at colchicine site inhibiting polymerization

nodes.label: β-catenin
nodes.description: Wnt pathway transcriptional co-activator; stabilized by PAK4; regulated by PKM2

nodes.label: Dasatinib
nodes.description: Multitargeted SFK inhibitor; inhibits LYN; synergizes with ivermectin; senolytic in combination with quercetin

nodes.label: Breast Cancer
nodes.description: Common malignancy; BRCA-mutant models; HER2-enriched and triple-negative subtypes sensitive to melittin

nodes.label: ovarian cancer
nodes.description: Ovarian malignancy; BRCA-associated; PAK4 overexpressed; ivermectin studied

nodes.label: Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
nodes.description: NPC; cancer where ivermectin shows PAK1-inhibitory activity

nodes.label: Gemcitabine
nodes.description: Nucleoside analog; standard chemotherapy for cholangiocarcinoma; resistance overcome by ivermectin

nodes.label: STING
nodes.description: Stimulator of interferon genes; central to cGAS-STING pathway; silenced in KRAS-LKB1 mutant lung cancer

nodes.label: KRAS
nodes.description: Oncogenic GTPase; mutated in colon and lung cancers; co-mutation with LKB1 silences STING

nodes.label: TP53
nodes.description: Tumor suppressor p53 gene; lost in colon cancer adenoma-carcinoma transition; mutated in many cancers

nodes.label: HMGB1
nodes.description: High mobility group box 1; nuclear DAMP released during necrosis and senescence; binds TLR4/RAGE

nodes.label: Immune Checkpoint
nodes.description: Immunoregulatory pathways; PD-L1/PD-1 axis; response depends on STING-SASP integrity

nodes.label: Multidrug Resistance
nodes.description: MDR; cancer resistance mechanism reversed by ivermectin via P-gp inhibition

nodes.label: Tumor Microenvironment
nodes.description: Tumor stroma including immune cells, fibroblasts, vasculature; modulated by DAMP, PGE2, and GABA signaling

nodes.label: Mectizan
nodes.description: Donated ivermectin brand for onchocerciasis and LF elimination programs

nodes.label: HSP27
nodes.description: Heat shock protein 27; survival chaperone; phosphorylation inhibited by ivermectin in lung cancer

nodes.label: MGMT
nodes.description: O6-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase; promoter methylation predicts temozolomide response in glioblastoma

nodes.label: RAC1
nodes.description: Small GTPase; activates PAK2 and PAK4; upstream of PKCι signaling

nodes.label: Cdc42
nodes.description: Small GTPase; activates PAK2 and PAK4; regulator of cell polarity and cytoskeleton

nodes.label: Wnt
nodes.description: β-catenin signaling pathway; inhibited by ivermectin and mebendazole; activated in colon cancer

nodes.label: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors
nodes.description: Drugs blocking PD-1/PD-L1 or CTLA-4; response depends on STING-SASP in KRAS-LKB1 lung cancer

nodes.label: Hedgehog signaling pathway
nodes.description: Developmental signaling pathway; suppressed by mebendazole limiting GLI-driven proliferation

nodes.label: Doxorubicin
nodes.description: Anthracycline chemotherapy; iRGD enhances tumor penetration; Bmi-1 confers resistance

nodes.label: NLRP3 inflammasome
nodes.description: Inflammasome complex; activated by DAMPs like uric acid and ATP

nodes.label: HUWE1
nodes.description: E3 ubiquitin ligase; ubiquitinates Mcl-1 for degradation; opposed by USP9X

nodes.label: Kitasato Institute
nodes.description: Japanese research institute where avermectin was discovered from soil actinomycetes

nodes.label: Melanoma
nodes.description: Skin cancer; sensitive to melittin and honeybee venom; oblimersen studied

nodes.label: Propolis
nodes.description: Bee resin with antioxidant and pro-apoptotic flavonoids; component of apitherapy

nodes.label: Wnt/β-catenin
nodes.description: Canonical Wnt signaling; inhibited by ivermectin and melittin; activated by PAK4

nodes.label: Death receptor
nodes.description: Fas, TRAIL-R; recruit DISC with pro-Caspase-8; regulated by LYN phosphorylation

nodes.label: IRF3
nodes.description: Interferon regulatory factor 3; phosphorylated by IKKε/TBK1 for type I IFN induction

nodes.label: Diethylcarbamazine
nodes.description: DEC; antifilarial drug killing microfilariae and adult worms in lymphatic filariasis

nodes.label: Free Radicals
nodes.description: Atoms/molecules with unpaired valence electrons; proximal agents of oxidative stress

nodes.label: Superoxide Radicals
nodes.description: Primary ROS formed by one-electron reduction of O2; precursor to H2O2, hydroxyl radical, and peroxynitrite

nodes.label: Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)
nodes.description: Key redox signaling agent; moderate stability; primary substrate for detoxification by catalase and GPX

nodes.label: Hydroxyl Radicals
nodes.description: Most reactive ROS; formed via Fenton reaction; reacts at diffusion-limited rate with any biomolecule

nodes.label: Singlet Oxygen
nodes.description: Excited-state molecular oxygen; non-radical ROS; targets double bonds in lipids and DNA

nodes.label: Nitric Oxide (NO)
nodes.description: Free radical signaling molecule; precursor to RNS; regulates vascular tone and neurotransmission

nodes.label: Peroxynitrite
nodes.description: Powerful oxidant formed from superoxide + NO; key mediator of nitrative stress; nitrates tyrosine residues

nodes.label: Nitrative Stress
nodes.description: Pathological condition where RNS production exceeds detoxification, causing protein nitration and damage

nodes.label: Reactive Nitrogen Species (RNS)
nodes.description: Antimicrobial and signaling molecules derived from NO and superoxide; cause nitrative stress

nodes.label: NADPH Oxidase (NOX)
nodes.description: Membrane-bound enzyme complex that deliberately produces superoxide for signaling and immunity

nodes.label: NOX2 (gp91phox)
nodes.description: Prototypical NOX catalytic subunit; primary phagocyte superoxide source during respiratory burst

nodes.label: NOX4
nodes.description: Constitutively active NOX isoform producing H2O2; drives senescence via p53/p21 and p16/Rb

nodes.label: Xanthine Oxidase (XO)
nodes.description: Purine catabolism enzyme producing superoxide and H2O2; central to ischemia-reperfusion injury

nodes.label: Nitric Oxide Synthase (NOS)
nodes.description: Family of enzymes producing NO from L-arginine; includes nNOS, iNOS, eNOS

nodes.label: iNOS (NOS2)
nodes.description: Inducible NOS isoform producing high sustained NO fluxes during inflammation; drives nitrative stress

nodes.label: Lipid Peroxidation
nodes.description: Free radical chain reaction degrading PUFAs in membranes; generates reactive aldehydes MDA and 4-HNE

nodes.label: Malondialdehyde (MDA)
nodes.description: Reactive dialdehyde end-product of lipid peroxidation; widely used oxidative stress biomarker

nodes.label: 4-Hydroxynonenal (4-HNE)
nodes.description: Reactive α,β-unsaturated aldehyde from n-6 PUFA peroxidation; signaling molecule at low concentrations

nodes.label: F2-Isoprostanes
nodes.description: Gold-standard biomarker of endogenous oxidative stress; non-enzymatic products of arachidonic acid peroxidation

nodes.label: Oxysterols
nodes.description: Oxygenated cholesterol derivatives; LXR ligands; promote plaque instability and apoptosis

nodes.label: 7-Ketocholesterol
nodes.description: Most abundant non-enzymatic oxysterol; pro-apoptotic and pro-inflammatory; major oxLDL component

nodes.label: Cholesterol
nodes.description: Essential sterol lipid; oxidation yields oxysterols and drives atherosclerosis

nodes.label: Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids (PUFAs)
nodes.description: Lipids with multiple double bonds; highly susceptible to peroxidation; drive ferroptosis

nodes.label: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine (8-oxodG)
nodes.description: Most abundant oxidative DNA lesion; biomarker of oxidative stress; drives G→T transversions

nodes.label: OGG1
nodes.description: Bifunctional glycosylase that excises 8-oxodG via base excision repair

nodes.label: Nucleic Acids
nodes.description: DNA and RNA; targets of ROS leading to base oxidation, strand breaks, and mutations

nodes.label: Ferritin
nodes.description: Iron storage protein limiting Fenton chemistry and protecting against ferroptosis

nodes.label: Aconitase
nodes.description: TCA cycle enzyme with [4Fe-4S] cluster; primary target of superoxide and peroxynitrite

nodes.label: NF-kappa B
nodes.description: Redox-sensitive master regulator of inflammation; activated by ROS; drives SASP transcription

nodes.label: Ferroptosis
nodes.description: Iron-dependent cell death driven by lipid peroxidation; regulated by GPX4

nodes.label: Mitochondria
nodes.description: Primary endogenous source of ROS; site of electron transport chain leakage

nodes.label: Atherosclerosis
nodes.description: Arterial plaque formation driven by oxLDL, inflammation, and oxidative stress

nodes.label: Superoxide Dismutase (SOD)
nodes.description: Primary enzymatic defense converting superoxide to H2O2; isoforms SOD1, SOD2, SOD3

nodes.label: Catalase
nodes.description: Decomposes H2O2 to H2O and O2 in peroxisomes; one of highest turnover rates

nodes.label: Glutathione Peroxidase (GPX)
nodes.description: Selenium-containing enzyme reducing H2O2 and organic hydroperoxides using glutathione

nodes.label: Glutathione (GSH)
nodes.description: Most abundant intracellular thiol; directly scavenges ROS and serves as GPX co-substrate

nodes.label: MitoQ
nodes.description: Mitochondria-targeted antioxidant; ubiquinone conjugated to TPP+ cation targeting mitochondria

nodes.label: Coenzyme Q10
nodes.description: Essential ETC component and lipid-soluble antioxidant; regenerates vitamin E

nodes.label: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
nodes.description: Universal antioxidant; recycles vitamin C, E, and glutathione; NRF2 activator

nodes.label: S-Nitrosylation
nodes.description: Reversible NO-mediated PTM of cysteine thiols; prototypical NO redox signaling mechanism

nodes.label: Hypochlorous Acid (HOCl)
nodes.description: Potent oxidant generated by MPO from H2O2 and Cl-; primary microbicidal agent in neutrophils

nodes.label: Myeloperoxidase (MPO)
nodes.description: Heme enzyme producing HOCl; key component of neutrophil antimicrobial defense

nodes.label: TXNIP
nodes.description: Redox-sensitive negative regulator of thioredoxin; links oxidative stress to NLRP3 inflammasome activation

nodes.label: MTH1
nodes.description: Nucleotide pool sanitization enzyme hydrolyzing 8-oxo-dGTP; prevents oxidized nucleotide incorporation

nodes.label: Allopurinol
nodes.description: XO inhibitor; lowers uric acid; antioxidant and cardiovascular protective properties

nodes.label: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatases (PTPs)
nodes.description: Redox-sensitive phosphatases; reversible oxidation of catalytic cysteine regulates signaling

nodes.label: 3-Nitrotyrosine (3-NT)
nodes.description: Covalent protein modification by peroxynitrite; specific biomarker of nitrative stress

nodes.label: Chronic Granulomatous Disease (CGD)
nodes.description: Primary immunodeficiency from NOX2 mutations; recurrent infections due to failed respiratory burst

nodes.label: Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
nodes.description: Tissue damage from reoxygenation after hypoxia; XO and mitochondria produce ROS burst

nodes.label: Mitohormesis
nodes.description: Low-level ROS trigger adaptive cytoprotective responses that enhance resilience

nodes.label: Senescent Cells
nodes.description: Arrested cells with apoptosis resistance; produce SASP; accumulate with age

nodes.label: Senescence Surveillance
nodes.description: Immune-mediated clearance of senescent cells via NK cells, macrophages, T cells

nodes.label: Paracrine Senescence
nodes.description: SASP factors induce senescence in neighboring healthy cells, spreading the phenotype

nodes.label: Oncogene-Induced Senescence (OIS)
nodes.description: Senescence triggered by activated oncogenes (RAS, BRAF); intrinsic tumor-suppressive barrier

nodes.label: Therapy-Induced Senescence (TIS)
nodes.description: Senescence triggered by chemotherapy or radiation; double-edged in cancer treatment

nodes.label: Immunosenescence
nodes.description: Age-related deterioration of immune function; linked to inflammaging

nodes.label: Inflammaging
nodes.description: Chronic low-grade inflammation during aging; driven by SASP and senescent cell accumulation

nodes.label: Senolytic
nodes.description: Compound that selectively induces apoptosis in senescent cells by targeting SCAPs

nodes.label: Senomorphic
nodes.description: Intervention that suppresses SASP without killing senescent cells

nodes.label: Senotherapeutic
nodes.description: Umbrella term for interventions targeting senescence: senolytics and senomorphics

nodes.label: Senotherapy
nodes.description: Therapeutic strategies targeting senescent cells or SASP to treat age-related disease

nodes.label: Senescent Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways (SCAPs)
nodes.description: Pro-survival network (BCL-2, PI3K/Akt, UPR) allowing senescent cells to resist apoptosis

nodes.label: Senescence-Associated Mitochondrial Dysfunction (SAMD)
nodes.description: Mitochondrial impairment in senescent cells; drives SASP via ROS and mtDNA release

nodes.label: Inflammasome
nodes.description: Cytosolic immune complexes activating caspase-1 to process IL-1 family cytokines

nodes.label: NLRP3 Inflammasome
nodes.description: Best-studied inflammasome; activated by diverse DAMPs including ROS, mtDNA, cholesterol crystals

nodes.label: Noncanonical Inflammasome
nodes.description: Caspase-5/11-driven inflammasome; cleaves IL-1α to drive SASP in senescent cells

nodes.label: p16 INK4a
nodes.description: CDK inhibitor enforcing long-term RB-dependent arrest; key in vivo senescence biomarker

nodes.label: p21 CIP1
nodes.description: CDK inhibitor induced by p53; early arrest effector in senescence

nodes.label: IL-1α
nodes.description: Apical SASP cytokine; cleaved by noncanonical inflammasome; upstream activator of IL-6/IL-8

nodes.label: IL-6
nodes.description: Core SASP cytokine; drives paracrine senescence; biomarker of aging

nodes.label: TGF-β
nodes.description: SASP factor promoting paracrine senescence and fibrosis; signals through SMAD2/3

nodes.label: Senolytic Therapy
nodes.description: Therapeutic clearance of senescent cells using senolytic compounds

nodes.label: Senomorphic Therapy
nodes.description: Therapeutic suppression of SASP without eliminating senescent cells

nodes.label: Fisetin
nodes.description: Flavonol with senolytic and senomorphic activity; extends healthspan in aged mice

nodes.label: Quercetin
nodes.description: Flavonoid senolytic; combined with dasatinib in D+Q senolytic regimen

nodes.label: Rapamycin
nodes.description: mTOR inhibitor; suppresses SASP translation; both senomorphic and autophagy-inducing

nodes.label: MyD88
nodes.description: Adaptor protein for IL-1R and TLR signaling; mediates SASP induction

nodes.label: IL-1R
nodes.description: IL-1 receptor; signaling through MyD88 drives SASP and paracrine senescence

nodes.label: DNA Damage Response (DDR)
nodes.description: Cellular response to DNA damage; persistent DDR signaling is primary senescence trigger

nodes.label: Telomere Attrition
nodes.description: Progressive telomere shortening; drives replicative senescence at Hayflick limit

nodes.label: Fenton Reaction
nodes.description: Fe2+ + H2O2 → Fe3+ + •OH + OH-; generates hydroxyl radicals; amplified by superoxide-released iron

nodes.label: Respiratory Burst
nodes.description: Rapid NOX2-dependent superoxide production in phagocytes for microbial killing

nodes.label: Endothelial Dysfunction
nodes.description: Impaired vasodilation from reduced NO bioavailability; driven by eNOS uncoupling and oxidative stress

nodes.label: Vitamin E (α-tocopherol)
nodes.description: Lipid-phase chain-breaking antioxidant; protects membranes from lipid peroxidation

nodes.label: Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C)
nodes.description: Aqueous-phase antioxidant; regenerates vitamin E from tocopheroxyl radical

nodes.label: Macrophages
nodes.description: Immune cells; clear senescent cells via phagocytosis; produce ROS/RNS via NOX2 and iNOS

nodes.label: Natural Killer Cells
nodes.description: Immune effectors directly killing senescent cells via NKG2D receptor recognition

nodes.label: HLA-E
nodes.description: Non-classical MHC class I molecule; may be involved in immune recognition of senescent cells

nodes.label: Proteins
nodes.description: Major targets of oxidative stress; undergo carbonylation, nitration, and oxidation

nodes.label: Lipids
nodes.description: Diverse organic compounds; PUFA-containing lipids are primary targets of lipid peroxidation

nodes.label: CD36 Receptor
nodes.description: Scavenger receptor for oxLDL; promotes foam cell formation in atherosclerosis

nodes.label: Genistein
nodes.description: Soy isoflavone with antioxidant properties

nodes.label: SIRT1
nodes.description: NAD+-dependent class III histone deacetylase; most extensively characterized sirtuin; primarily nuclear, regulates chromatin, stress resistance, metabolism, and longevity

nodes.label: SIRT2
nodes.description: Cytoplasmic/nuclear sirtuin (Class Ib); tubulin deacetylase; regulates cell cycle, autophagy, glioma suppression

nodes.label: SIRT3
nodes.description: Primary mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase; master regulator of mitochondrial metabolism, ROS detoxification, AceCS2 activation, and thermogenesis

nodes.label: SIRT4
nodes.description: Mitochondrial sirtuin (Class II); primary mono-ADP-ribosyl transferase; inhibits GDH to regulate insulin secretion; downregulated by caloric restriction

nodes.label: SIRT5
nodes.description: Mitochondrial sirtuin (Class III); primary lysine desuccinylase/demalonylase/deglutarylase; activates CPS1 and HMGCS2; regulates urea cycle and ketogenesis

nodes.label: SIRT6
nodes.description: Nuclear chromatin-associated sirtuin (Class IVa); longevity gene; regulates DNA repair, LINE-1 repression, glycolysis suppression, and inflammation

nodes.label: SIRT7
nodes.description: Nucleolar sirtuin (Class IVb); activator of RNA Pol I transcription; regulates ribosome biogenesis, heterochromatin stability, and cardiac protection

nodes.label: SIRT3/SIRT4 Ratio
nodes.description: Quantitative balance between opposing SIRT3 (activates MnSOD) and SIRT4 (inhibits MnSOD) activities; functions as mitochondrial redox dial determining hormetic window

nodes.label: Deacetylation
nodes.description: Enzymatic removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues; catalyzed by NAD+-dependent sirtuin deacetylases; central to metabolic sensing, chromatin regulation, and longevity

nodes.label: ADP-ribosylation
nodes.description: Reversible post-translational modification transferring ADP-ribose from NAD+ to target proteins; mono-ADP-ribosylation by SIRT4/SIRT6 and poly-ADP-ribosylation by PARP1

nodes.label: NADH
nodes.description: Reduced form of NAD+; NAD+/NADH ratio determines sirtuin activity; high ratio activates sirtuins

nodes.label: cADPR
nodes.description: Cyclic ADP-ribose; second messenger synthesized from NAD+ by CD38; regulates intracellular calcium via ryanodine receptors

nodes.label: OAADPr
nodes.description: 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose; unique by-product of sirtuin-catalyzed NAD+-dependent deacetylation; activates TRPM2 ion channels

nodes.label: MnSOD
nodes.description: Manganese Superoxide Dismutase (SOD2); primary mitochondrial antioxidant enzyme; deacetylated/activated by SIRT3, inhibited by SIRT4

nodes.label: AceCS2
nodes.description: Mitochondrial acetyl-CoA synthetase 2; activated by SIRT3 deacetylation; converts acetate to acetyl-CoA for TCA cycle

nodes.label: UCP2
nodes.description: Uncoupling protein 2; mitochondrial inner membrane proton transporter; transcriptionally repressed by SIRT1 in pancreatic β-cells

nodes.label: CPS1
nodes.description: Carbamoyl phosphate synthase 1; rate-limiting enzyme of urea cycle; activated by SIRT5 desuccinylation

nodes.label: GDH
nodes.description: Glutamate dehydrogenase; mitochondrial enzyme linking amino acid catabolism to TCA cycle; inhibited by SIRT4 mono-ADP-ribosylation

nodes.label: PTP1B
nodes.description: Protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B; negative regulator of insulin signaling; downregulated by SIRT1

nodes.label: TAFI68
nodes.description: TBP-associated factor I 68; subunit of TIF-IB/SL1; first non-histone substrate of SIRT1; represses RNA Pol I transcription when deacetylated

nodes.label: Sirtuin Activators
nodes.description: Compounds and interventions that increase sirtuin catalytic efficiency or expression; include polyphenol STACs, synthetic STACs, NAD+ precursors, and lifestyle factors

nodes.label: Stilbene
nodes.description: Class of polyphenolic organic compounds with 1,2-diphenylethylene core; includes resveratrol, pterostilbene; phytoalexins with sirtuin-activating properties

nodes.label: Stilbenoid
nodes.description: Subclass of polyphenolic phytoalexins with stilbene backbone; includes resveratrol; SIRT1 activators with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities

nodes.label: Honokiol
nodes.description: Bioactive biphenolic lignan from Magnolia species; direct SIRT3 activator; cardioprotective, neuroprotective, anti-inflammatory

nodes.label: Cyanidin
nodes.description: Natural anthocyanidin; potent SIRT6 allosteric activator (>50-fold in vitro); found in berries; enhances H3K9/H3K56 deacetylation

nodes.label: Dihydromyricetin
nodes.description: Natural flavonoid (Ampelopsin) from vine tea; accessible dietary SIRT3 activator; co-activates AMPK; hepatoprotective and neuroprotective

nodes.label: Fucoidan
nodes.description: Sulfated polysaccharide from brown seaweeds; SIRT6 activator that elevates protein levels and enhances mADPr activity; mimics centenarian SIRT6 variants

nodes.label: Mediterranean Diet
nodes.description: Dietary pattern with high polyphenol intake; activates SIRT1 via resveratrol; associated with reduced cardiovascular disease and improved longevity

nodes.label: SRT1720
nodes.description: Synthetic second-generation STAC; potent SIRT1 activator; improves insulin sensitivity and extends lifespan in HFD-fed mice

nodes.label: SRT2104
nodes.description: Synthetic allosteric SIRT1 activator; orally bioavailable STAC; entered clinical trials for psoriasis, endotoxemia, and metabolic disorders

nodes.label: MDL-800
nodes.description: Bis-benzenesulfonamide synthetic allosteric SIRT6 activator; parent compound of MDL-801; anti-fibrotic and pro-angiogenic

nodes.label: MDL-801
nodes.description: Optimized bis-benzenesulfonamide SIRT6 allosteric activator; more potent than MDL-800; downregulates TGF-β1/Smad pathway

nodes.label: UBCS039
nodes.description: First synthetic selective allosteric SIRT6 activator; binds hydrophobic pocket; tumor-suppressive and organ-protective effects

nodes.label: EX-527
nodes.description: Potent SIRT1 inhibitor (Selisistat); nicotinamide analog; induces p53 hyperacetylation and apoptosis; studied in oncology and Huntington's disease

nodes.label: Sirtinol
nodes.description: Beta-naphthol dual SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitor; induces senescence-like growth arrest and autophagic cell death in cancer cells

nodes.label: Salermide
nodes.description: Beta-naphthol sirtinol derivative; potent SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitor; tumor-selective antiproliferative effects; reactivates proapoptotic genes

nodes.label: Cambinol
nodes.description: Beta-naphthol derivative SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitor; anti-migratory and chemo-sensitizing properties in cancer models

nodes.label: Splitomicin
nodes.description: Beta-naphthol lactone sirtuin inhibitor; discovered in yeast Sir2 screen; inhibits SIRT1 and SIRT2; modulates NF-κB translocation

nodes.label: Tenovins
nodes.description: Family of SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitors (Tenovin-1, Tenovin-6); discovered in p53-activation screen; induce p53-dependent apoptosis in cancer cells

nodes.label: AGK2
nodes.description: Selective SIRT2 inhibitor; neuroprotective in Parkinson's disease models; rescues dopaminergic neurons from alpha-synuclein toxicity

nodes.label: Compound C
nodes.description: AMPK inhibitor (Dorsomorphin); used to probe AMPK dependence in sirtuin and adrenochrome signaling pathways

nodes.label: NMN
nodes.description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide; NAD+ precursor that boosts sirtuin activity by elevating NAD+ levels

nodes.label: NR
nodes.description: Nicotinamide riboside; NAD+ precursor that elevates cellular NAD+ levels and drives sirtuin-dependent deacetylation

nodes.label: CD38 Inhibitor 78c
nodes.description: Potent selective CD38 inhibitor; preserves NAD+ levels by blocking CD38 NADase; extends healthspan in mice

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Biogenesis
nodes.description: Process of increasing mitochondrial mass and copy number; driven by PGC-1α; regulated by SIRT1 deacetylation of PGC-1α

nodes.label: ABCA1
nodes.description: ATP-binding cassette transporter A1; mediates cholesterol efflux to apoA-1; initiates HDL biogenesis; regulated by LXR and resveratrol

nodes.label: Cholesterol
nodes.description: Substrate transported by ABCA1 to apoA-1 for HDL formation

nodes.label: Liver X Receptor
nodes.description: Master transcriptional activator of ABCA1 expression

nodes.label: Resveratrol
nodes.description: Upregulates ABCA1 expression and enhances cholesterol efflux

nodes.label: Atherosclerosis
nodes.description: Disease protected against by ABCA1-mediated cholesterol removal

nodes.label: ADP
nodes.description: Adenosine diphosphate; low-energy adenine nucleotide; signal of cellular energy deficit in mitohormesis

nodes.label: ATP
nodes.description: Adenosine triphosphate; universal energy currency; interconverted with ADP

nodes.label: AMPK
nodes.description: AMP-activated protein kinase; central metabolic sensor activated by rising ADP/AMP

nodes.label: Creatine
nodes.description: Recycles ADP to ATP via phosphocreatine shuttle

nodes.label: Mitohormesis
nodes.description: Hormetic response to mitochondrial stress; ADP rise activates AMPK/PGC-1α axis

nodes.label: SIRT1
nodes.description: NAD+-dependent deacetylase; reciprocally activates AMPK

nodes.label: Autophagy
nodes.description: Cellular cleanup process regulated by AMPK

nodes.label: Aging
nodes.description: Time-dependent decline where AMPK activity typically declines

nodes.label: Epigenetic Clock
nodes.description: DNA methylation-based biological age measurement; AMPK activation may slow it

nodes.label: APOE4
nodes.description: Apolipoprotein E epsilon 4; major genetic risk factor for Alzheimer's disease

nodes.label: TREM2
nodes.description: Receptor on microglia; APOE4 synergizes with TREM2 R47H variant

nodes.label: cGAS-STING Pathway
nodes.description: Amplified by APOE4/TREM2 synergy in microglia driving neuroinflammation

nodes.label: Alzheimer's Disease
nodes.description: Neurodegenerative disease for which APOE4 is the strongest genetic risk factor

nodes.label: Microglia
nodes.description: Brain immune cells in which APOE4 primes inflammatory and senescent states

nodes.label: APP
nodes.description: Amyloid precursor protein; proteolysis generates beta-amyloid peptides

nodes.label: Beta-amyloid
nodes.description: Proteolytic fragment of APP; principal component of amyloid plaques

nodes.label: BACE1
nodes.description: Beta-secretase that initiates amyloidogenic processing of APP

nodes.label: Gamma-Secretase
nodes.description: Intramembrane protease complex that liberates Aβ from APP CTFs

nodes.label: Presenilin 1
